admission.justification: The public producer, file storage, lifecycle or native transport owners must preserve this same boundary across their distinct source locations.

applicability: Validated role_message deliveries and host-refused native send attempts.
conditions: A message can proceed past pre-delivery validation and selection capacity admission.
exclusions: Developer chat text and native host chat display
Messages via removed earlier orchestration tools
Validation/admission refusals before a native send attempt do not retain a delivery record.

evidence: MessageFileTests, RefusedFileTests and _FailingWriter fault-injection (L117-C1-F01); op counts at sizes 10/40 plus concurrency (L117-C1-F08); checks-attempt4/pytest-focused.log; worker report Attempt 4

statement: Every delivery is filed whole before send: one staged write plus fsync plus one atomic link per message; a refused delivery keeps a .undelivered.md file naming the refusal.
